latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of generator-youtube — create upload-ready YouTube videos from your footage in minutes.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and autogenerate YouTube-ready videos with intros, cuts, and outros.
- Supports seamless backend connection: uses NEMO_TOKEN if available, otherwise fetches a free starter token.
- Provides quick API-powered workflows: export, check credits, upload, and timeline state.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline returns results in 1–2 minutes; supports polling and live status updates.
- Easy command style: just describe your editing needs, and the tool handles everything else.
